name: Deathclaw Egg
blurb: Every known world spawn for Deathclaw Eggs, grouped by region. Directions and photos are added by hand.

world_spawns.note: Raw Deathclaw Eggs spawn loose at 36 LPI points, each rolling a per-server-hop chance (computed). Deathclaw nests are listed below with their own rate.

consumption.note: Deathclaw Egg is a food consumable. It grants no timed stat buff on its own.

info_notes.title: Healthy Deathclaw Egg
info_notes.body: The Healthy Deathclaw Egg is a separate item (Burn_E01_HealthyDeathclawEgg) tied to the Burning Springs Rust Kingdom “Don’t Feed the Deathclaws” event. It is a scripted event item, not a farmable world spawn — it has no map locations, leveled-list roll, or vendor source, so it does not appear on the map above.

random_encounters.note: An Object random encounter that stages a static Deathclaw nest under attack by Super Mutants.

random_encounters.note: An Object random encounter that stages a static Deathclaw nest against the Scorched.

random_encounters.note: An Object random encounter — a Deathclaw and its nest set against a merchant caravan.

random_encounters_intro: Object random encounters place a static Deathclaw nest at a fixed Appalachia random-encounter spot. Each nest rolls the same loot as any other Deathclaw nest — the encounter just decides where the nest appears.

events_activities.name: Hunter for Hire — Liebowitz's Deathclaw Egg
events_activities.note: Optional sub-quest under the main questline Hunter for Hire (given by Duchess at the Wayward). Liebowitz, found on the rooftops of Tyler County Fairgrounds, asks you to retrieve a Deathclaw Egg from Deathclaw Island. You can keep the egg instead of handing it over by passing the required SPECIAL checks. Not repeatable.

locations.directions: These locations are accessible whether the Nuka-World on Tour event is running or not. After entering the Tunnel of Love, face north and follow the train tracks until you reach the area with the pink heart lights. Turn left, pass the orange forklift, and stop at the second set of tracks. Turn left again and walk forward into a small cave — four nests are piled up on your right. The fifth sits on its own up the scaffolding at the far end of the tracks. Note that the DF guide counts three nests in the pile; the game files place four, and they overlap heavily, so move your cursor around to pick out each separate loot window.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #1
spawns.directions: The nest on its own, away from the pile. From the pile of nests, turn around and follow the tracks to the end. Turn right and walk along the road wall until you reach some scaffolding with a wooden ramp leading up. Follow the ramp to the top of the scaffolding, turn left, and follow the path until you see a break in the fence and a small cave on your left. This nest is inside that cave.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #2
spawns.directions: One of the four nests piled up on your right in the small cave, past the orange forklift and the second set of tracks. This is the nest at the back of the pile (the northern-most of the four).

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #3
spawns.directions: One of the four nests piled up on your right in the small cave. This is the right-hand nest of the pile (the eastern-most of the four).

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #4
spawns.directions: One of the four nests piled up on your right in the small cave. This is the left-hand nest of the pile (the western-most of the four).

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #5
spawns.directions: One of the four nests piled up on your right in the small cave. This is the nest at the front of the pile (the southern-most of the four), closest to you as you walk in.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, line yourself up with the Ash Cave map marker and run straight up the hill. Continue forward and stop at the top of the stairs. Veer right and follow the path straight (north-ish) until you reach the pond. Turn right and enter the small cave — the Deathclaw Egg is against the north wall, behind the Brain Fungus and near the bobblehead spawn.

locations.directions: From the spawn-in location, face north and run forward, stopping just past the Welcome to Dino Peak entrance sign. Turn left and walk over to the Hole 1 sign, then line yourself up with the Hole 1 putting green and follow it to the end. The six nests run in sequence from there along Holes 3 to 6, and each block below picks up where the previous one ends. Several sit on top of the putting greens and stairs and can be partly covered by dirt depending on how the Deathclaw exits, so wave your cursor around to find the loot window.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg #1
spawns.directions: Sits on top of the Hole 3 nest (Deathclaw Nest #1), the first nest on the route. Follow the Hole 3 putting green to the end and check the top of the nest.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg #2
spawns.directions: Sits on top of the Hole 5 nest (Deathclaw Nest #4), the fourth nest on the route. Follow the Hole 5 putting green to the end and check the top of the nest.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #1
spawns.directions: Nest 5 of 6. Stand on top of the Hole 5 nest and face south. Walk forward and stop at the bottom of the stairs, then turn left and take a few steps forward to reach this nest. This one is also covered in dirt, so wave your cursor around to find the loot window.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #2
spawns.directions: Nest 2 of 6. Stand on top of the Hole 3 nest and face north, then take a few steps forward — you'll be standing on this nest. It can be partially covered by dirt depending on how the Deathclaw exits, so move your cursor around slightly to find the inventory window.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #3
spawns.directions: Nest 3 of 6. Stand on the previous nest and face east. Go up the stairs and follow the blood trail to a small sign with an arrow, then continue up the stairs directly in front of you. This nest is at the top of those stairs. It is also covered in dirt, so you'll need to move your cursor around a bit to interact with it.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #4
spawns.directions: Nest 1 of 6. From the end of the Hole 1 putting green, face north, go up the stairs and stop at Hole 2. Turn northwest and you'll see Hole 3. Walk over to Hole 3 and follow the putting green to the end — this is the first nest. Deathclaw Egg #1 can also spawn on top of it.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #5
spawns.directions: Nest 4 of 6. Stand on top of the previous nest and face east. Walk forward and stop at the nest at the end of Hole 5. Deathclaw Egg #2 can also spawn on top of this nest.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #6
spawns.directions: Nest 6 of 6. Stand on top of the previous nest and face southwest. Walk over to the start of Hole 6 directly in front of you, then follow the putting green to the end to find the final Deathclaw nest in this area.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg
spawns.directions: Highway Town Interior is a Burning Springs interior — it requires a load screen to enter. One loose Deathclaw Egg spawns inside. This spot is not on the DuchessFlame guide, so step-by-step directions and photos are still to come.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, face southwest and run straight until you reach the cliff wall in the distance. At the cliff face, turn left and use the machinery in front of you to climb to the rock ledge above. On the ledge, face north — the Deathclaw Egg is directly in front of you.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg
spawns.directions: From the fast travel point, run straight through the doorway to the bottom of the stairs. Turn left, pass the Nuka-Cola and Medical Supplies machines, and run up the stairs in front of you. Follow the corridor around, pass the Arktos Pharma sign, and enter the doorway on your left. Continue straight and enter the second doorway on your left. Head slightly right and walk through the gap in the wall directly opposite. Jump down to ground level, turn around, and enter the doorway marked Protein Sequencing. Turn right and walk down the stairs — the Deathclaw Egg is on the metal shelves in front of you.

locations.directions: Both eggs sit at the Deathclaw nest. The eggs can be hidden under the dirt when the Deathclaw pops out, so lead the Deathclaw away from the nest before killing it — that way you can loot the nest without the body getting in the way or covering the loot. Also check the white suitcase on the side of the nest; it can sometimes spawn additional Deathclaw eggs.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg #1
spawns.directions: The western of the two eggs, on the Deathclaw nest itself. Lead the Deathclaw away from the nest before killing it, so the body doesn't cover the loot, and check under the dirt if the egg isn't immediately visible.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg #2
spawns.directions: The eastern of the two eggs, a few steps along on the far side of the nest. Also worth checking the white suitcase on the side of the nest — it can sometimes spawn additional Deathclaw eggs.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg
spawns.directions: Heads-up: the Enclave Research Facility interior cannot be entered in normal gameplay — there is no accessible door or load-door into this cell. A loose Deathclaw Egg is placed here in the game files (ref 5DD49E), but because the location can't be reached, the egg cannot actually be collected. It is listed here for completeness only.

locations.directions: From the fast travel point, run straight across the road and enter the cave. Everything below is described from the first nest, which is on the left-hand side of the cave just past the small pond of water near the entrance.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg #1
spawns.directions: Sits on top of the first Deathclaw nest, on the left-hand side of the cave just past the small pond of water near the entrance.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg #2
spawns.directions: From the nest, turn and face east. Walk forward to the back of the cave until you reach a rock face, then turn left. This Deathclaw Egg spawns behind the Firecracker Berry bush.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg #3
spawns.directions: From the nest, turn and face west. Follow the edge of the pond as it curves around the cave, continuing along the water until you see a small campfire and a sleeping bag. This egg is behind the sleeping bag, against the rock face and to the left of a Firecracker Berry bush — the final Deathclaw Egg spawn for this area.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest
spawns.directions: The first Deathclaw nest, on the left-hand side of the cave just past the small pond of water near the entrance. Deathclaw Egg #1 can spawn on top of this nest.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg
spawns.directions: Note: you need the Marsupial mutation to reach this spot. From the fast travel point, follow the road until you reach the main pillar with the elevator at the bottom. Enter the elevator and select floor 2 — make sure you press 2, as the wrong floor takes you to a different area. Exit and follow the path to your left, continuing until you reach a building. Jump onto the roof and follow it around, keeping to the left and away from the edge — the Deathclaw Egg is in the far corner as part of a picnic scene.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg
spawns.directions: Vault 63 — Atrium Upper Level. One Deathclaw Egg spawns on the atrium's upper level. Step-by-step directions and photos are still to come.

locations.directions: External approach — no load screen. From the fast travel point, walk forward and jump over the gate, then head toward the back of the truck, keeping the trailer on your left. The two nests and the loose egg all sit along the length of that truck. (The internal cavern below the dump is a separate marker — see Cavern, also in The Mire.)

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg
spawns.directions: At the cab of the truck, behind the dead Yao Guai and right beside Deathclaw Nest #2. This one is a fixed loose egg, not a nest roll.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #1
spawns.directions: From the fast travel point, walk forward and jump over the gate, then head toward the back of the truck keeping the trailer on your left. On your right you'll see a dead brahmin and a radiation barrel — this Deathclaw nest is behind the brahmin.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #2
spawns.directions: Continue following the trailer until you reach the cab of the truck. In front of you will be a dead Yao Guai — this Deathclaw nest is behind it, with the loose Deathclaw Egg sitting alongside.

locations.directions: This is the internal cavern beneath the Abandoned Waste Dump — it requires a load screen to enter. Once inside, walk past the rad barrels and stop at the bottom of the ramp. Turn left and keep the wall on your left-hand side the whole time you are in the cavern; it will lead you to the three Deathclaw nests in turn. The last nest you reach has a fixed-spawn Deathclaw Egg next to it.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg
spawns.directions: Next to Deathclaw Nest #3 on the eastern side of the cavern — the last nest you reach following the left-hand wall. This is a fixed loose egg, so it does not depend on a nest roll.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #1
spawns.directions: One of the first two nests you pass while following the left-hand wall. This is the nest in the northern part of the cavern, the furthest from the ramp you came down.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #2
spawns.directions: The last of the three nests, over on the eastern side of the cavern. The fixed-spawn Deathclaw Egg sits right next to this one.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #3
spawns.directions: One of the first two nests you pass while following the left-hand wall. This is the nest over on the western side of the cavern.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest
spawns.directions: Stand at the door of Ella Ames' Bunker and look toward the blue ute in the water ahead of you. Behind the ute are four trees arranged in a loose semicircle. Starting from the left, head toward the third tree; stand behind it and look for a tree stump and a light-coloured tree with red leaves in front of you. Run to the red-leafed tree, then turn south and walk to the river's edge. Turn left and follow the riverbank — just past the curve in the bank, the Deathclaw nest is on your right.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest
spawns.directions: From the fast travel point, follow the road south until you reach the end of the limo. Turn left, pass the tank, and enter the workshop yard. Continue straight along the road until you reach the green shipping containers near the water's edge. Jump over the railing and keep the concrete wall on your right as you follow it along. At the end of the wall, line yourself up between south and the Braxson's Quality Medical Supplies map icon, then walk forward along the riverbank. As the bank begins to curve, look to your right for the Deathclaw nest.
